Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — elevated GPU queue and pod evictions in eu-central-1 affecting inference-pool-7. Alert threshold exceeded for 12m. Paging on-call.

Alice (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a steady rise in queued requests and multiple pod restarts. Taking the triage. @Ben SRE can you check node events and recent scaling ops?

Ben SRE: checking cluster events now. Found repeated OOMKilled on sidecars causing node pressure. Also noticed cluster-autoscaler logs show 'ignored metric: gpu_util not found'.

Omar (eng-sre): That's suspicious — config drift in metrics mapping again. Which config version on pool-7?

Ben SRE: pool-7 uses config v2.1.3 per gitops, but the live config shows metric_name: node_cpu_percent (should be gpu_util_pct). Might have been an accidental manual edit last week.

Alice (oncall): Ok. Quick mitigation options: 1) increase the pool min nodes to buy time, 2) disable sidecars for the busiest deployments temporarily, 3) failover a portion of traffic to eu-west-2. Which do we want to do first?

Clara (prodops): Suggest bumping nodes first to reduce tail latencies for customers while we fix config. I'll prepare the routing plan in case we need it.

Alice (oncall): Running scale command to add 4 nodes to pool-7.

DevOps Bot: Executing: redwood infra adjust --region eu-central-1 --pool inference-pool-7 --add-nodes 4 -> queued (eta 3-5m).
